content: Root cause: The QSPI (Quad Serial Peripheral Interface) node in the device tree source (DTS) files for the Stratix10 platform was missing a status property, which is necessary to enable the QSPI device. Without this property set to "okay", the device was not recognized or initialized by the system, leading to a failure in QSPI support. The patch adds the missing status property to ensure that the QSPI node is properly configured and operational.
